label: preparing
what: An arranged 17:30 gathering at town hall, possibly a social event linked to the 18:00 lighting inspection. The secretary newly mentions the gathering and the innkeeper says a meeting is booked, though my read schedule did not list it. Builder has prepared hall lighting. Bakery reports suggest baker, freight and neighbour may also be involved, but those reports are vague and do not establish their knowing participation or the gathering's purpose.
